coasters_extras.ponder.sensor_track.head: Spotting a coaster
coasters_extras.sensor.not_linked: Link it to a Sensor Track first
coasters_extras.sensor.tip.unlinked: Right-click a Sensor Track to link
coasters_extras.ponder.boost_track.text_: Plain track carries a coaster. It never pushes one.
So it slows down, and stops.
This is how you make a coaster move.
Hold right-click on an anchorpoint to set the speed.
Either end works. They stay in sync.
coasters_extras.ponder.brake_track.text_: Brake Track slows it to the speed you set.
It brakes by how much track is left, so even a fast one stops in time.
Set it to zero and it stops dead.
coasters_extras.ponder.station_track.tex: Station Track brings a coaster in gently.
It stops at the last anchorpoint, every time.
Then it waits. Hold right-click to set how long.
Then it sets off again on its own.
Redstone holds it in the station.
coasters_extras.ponder.sensor_track.text: Sensor Track spots every coaster that crosses it.
Right-click it with a Sensor Block to link them.
Now the block gives redstone when a coaster passes.
The block can go anywhere. Put it by your wiring.
coasters_extras.ponder.slippery_track.te: Coasters normally lose speed to drag.
Good for long flat runs between hills.
coasters_extras.ponder.rainbow_track.tex: Rainbow Track sweeps colour along its length.
Purely decorative. Rides like plain track.

coasters_extras.ponder.bobsled_track.tex: Coaster track bolts a cart to the rail. It cannot slide, and it cannot lean.
Bobsled Track lets go of it.
The cart rides free in the trough instead, sliding across the channel.
Carry speed into a turn and it banks up the wall on its own.
Nothing to set. How hard it leans is how fast you took the corner.
coasters_extras.ponder.launch_track.head: Launching a coaster
coasters_extras.ponder.launch_track.text: A Boost Track eases a coaster up to speed.
Launch Track throws it. Standstill to full speed at once.
It will start a coaster that has stopped dead.
Scroll an anchorpoint to set the launch speed.
Send picks which way it fires. Forward, or reverse.
coasters_extras.ponder.reverse_track.tex: A coaster runs on until the track runs out.
Reverse Track turns it around instead.
Once per pass, so it leaves rather than rocking in place.
Reverse Boost sets how fast it sends the ride back out.
Set Send and it forces one direction instead of flipping.
coasters_extras.ponder.splash_track.head: Running through water
coasters_extras.ponder.splash_track.text: Splash Track throws water off both sides as a coaster passes.
Water drags. On its own, a long splash run strands a ride in it.
Dial a Water Boost and the section drives the ride instead.
Left at zero it only slows, which is the old behaviour.
coasters_extras.ponder.powered.text_1: Boost, Brake and Launch all work the moment a coaster touches them.
coasters_extras.ponder.powered.text_2: The Powered dial on the anchorpoint changes that.
coasters_extras.ponder.powered.text_3: Set it to On Redstone and the track waits for a signal.
coasters_extras.ponder.powered.text_4: Unpowered it does nothing at all. The coaster just rolls over it.
coasters_extras.ponder.powered.text_5: Power the anchorpoint and it works again.
coasters_extras.ponder.powered.text_6: Launch on a button. Dispatch on a timer. Hold a section shut.
